name: Dispelling Blow (Combat, Critical)
body:
Your critical hits can cut through spells.

Benefit: When you score a critical hit with a magic weapon or a spell, you can forgo dealing extra damage to instead affect the target with a dispel effect. Treat this as the targeted dispel option of the dispel magic spell. You can either use your actual caster level for the dispel check, or treat your base attack bonus as your caster level. You gain a +4 bonus on your dispel check if your weapon has greater than a x2 critical multiplier.

Special: You can apply the effects of only one critical feat to a given critical hit unless you possess Critical Mastery.
